title: Imp Jar Select Kiwi Passion Fruit & Guava 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Imp Jar Select Kiwi, Passion Fruit and Guava is a complex tropical blend. It balances the sweet, exotic flavour of Guava and the tangy, sharp taste of Passionfruit with a fresh slice of Kiwi. It is a vibrant and layered flavour profile perfect for summer. The Imp Jar Select nic salt range utilise twice as much flavour concentrate as standard e-liquids for an intense flavour payoff which pairs perfectly with vape starter kits and refillable vape kits . Launched in conjunction with Imp Jar's first pod vape kit, the Imp Jar Select, Imp Jar Select Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
